profile.summary: The Crucible is a nonprofit art school in West Oakland that teaches fine and industrial arts such as welding, blacksmithing, glass, and ceramics to people of many ages and backgrounds. It also offers scholarships, free programs, and youth programs, including work with Oakland public school students.

sources.title: For McClymonds High School Students, In-Person Crucible Classes Offer A Respite
